maddeler.e:
ينتقل (form VIII)
# يَنْتَقِلُ (yantaqilu) /jan.ta.qi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# يُنْتَقَلُ (yuntaqalu) /jun.ta.qa.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# يَنْتَقِلَ (yantaqila) /jan.ta.qi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْتَقَلَ (intaqala)
# يُن
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
